# Publishing: Boosty

See [the Boosty guide](../../publishing/boosty.md) for how to get these values.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `publish.boosty.access`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_ACCESS`<br>`--publish-boosty-access` | string | `free` | who can read the post: free, paid (a one-time price) or level (a subscription tier) |
| `publish.boosty.access-token`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_ACCESS_TOKEN`<br>`--publish-boosty-access-token` | string | — | Boosty access token, taken from a signed-in browser session; it expires **Secret**: redacted by `crier config`. |
| `publish.boosty.api-base-url`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_API_BASE_URL`<br>`--publish-boosty-api-base-url` | string | `https://api.boosty.to` | Boosty API base URL; the API is unofficial and undocumented, so it is configurable |
| `publish.boosty.blog`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_BLOG`<br>`--publish-boosty-blog` | string | — | blog to post in: the slug in boosty.to/<blog> |
| `publish.boosty.caption`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_CAPTION`<br>`--publish-boosty-caption` | string | — | Boosty specific post text |
| `publish.boosty.currency`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_CURRENCY`<br>`--publish-boosty-currency` | string | `RUB` | currency publish.boosty.price is quoted in, sent as the X-Currency header |
| `publish.boosty.device-id`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_DEVICE_ID`<br>`--publish-boosty-device-id` | string | — | the browser session's device id, which a refresh will not run without **Secret**: redacted by `crier config`. |
| `publish.boosty.enabled`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_ENABLED`<br>`--publish-boosty-enabled` | bool | — | publish to a Boosty blog |
| `publish.boosty.fit`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_FIT`<br>`--publish-boosty-fit` | string | `none` | how the render is made to match boosty's frame: none, cover, contain or stretch; anything but none needs width and height |
| `publish.boosty.fit-background`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_FIT_BACKGROUND`<br>`--publish-boosty-fit-background` | string | `#ffffff` | hex colour behind a contain letterbox for boosty, and what transparency is flattened onto |
| `publish.boosty.height`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_HEIGHT`<br>`--publish-boosty-height` | int | — | render height for boosty; 0 inherits render.height |
| `publish.boosty.lead-video`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_LEAD_VIDEO`<br>`--publish-boosty-lead-video` | string, path | — | not available: a boosty post is pictures or a video and never both, so a value here is refused rather than ignored |
| `publish.boosty.level-id`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_LEVEL_ID`<br>`--publish-boosty-level-id` | string | — | subscription level id the post is limited to; required when access is level |
| `publish.boosty.max-attachments`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_MAX_ATTACHMENTS`<br>`--publish-boosty-max-attachments` | int | — | post at most this many pages to boosty at once; 0 uses the platform's own limit, which is also the ceiling |
| `publish.boosty.music-file`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_MUSIC_FILE`<br>`--publish-boosty-music-file` | string, path | — | not available: boosty has no API for attaching an audio file, so a value here is refused rather than ignored |
| `publish.boosty.overlay`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_OVERLAY`<br>`--publish-boosty-overlay` | list, path | — | template overlays applied for boosty only, after the global ones |
| `publish.boosty.price`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_PRICE`<br>`--publish-boosty-price` | int | — | one-time price the post is unlocked by, in publish.boosty.currency; required when access is paid |
| `publish.boosty.refresh-token`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_REFRESH_TOKEN`<br>`--publish-boosty-refresh-token` | string | — | Boosty refresh token; with device-id it renews an expired access token, and boosty replaces it every time it is used **Secret**: redacted by `crier config`. |
| `publish.boosty.title`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_TITLE`<br>`--publish-boosty-title` | string | — | Boosty post title; empty uses the caption's first line |
| `publish.boosty.upload-base-url`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_UPLOAD_BASE_URL`<br>`--publish-boosty-upload-base-url` | string | `https://upload.boosty.to` | Boosty upload host; media goes here rather than to the API host |
| `publish.boosty.width`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_BOOSTY_WIDTH`<br>`--publish-boosty-width` | int | — | render width for boosty; 0 inherits render.width |

A sample carrying every key with its default is at
[`crier.example.yaml`](../../../crier.example.yaml).
